NMS 06:00 | MAJOR | BER26 | rectifier input lost (mains), DC on batteries
NMS 06:00 | MAJOR | NEG45 | rectifier input lost (mains), DC on batteries
NMS 06:00 | CRITICAL | MW hop KEL26<->NEG45 | LOS, link down

finding.finding: Verified: Beruwala grid power is unavailable, Negombo grid power is unavailable, and the Kelaniya–Negombo backhaul link is down. No equipment condition is established.

The resolved faults are S01 and S16 without grid power, and failed backhaul link L16. Equipment is otherwise operational; no road closures or unresolved facts are recorded. The catalogue includes a matching generator action for each unpowered site and a repair action for L16.
